content.short: Abstract is a consumer-focused Layer 2 blockchain built on Ethereum using the ZK stack for high speed and low costs.
content.description: Abstract is a highly scalable Ethereum Layer 2 network developed by Igloo Inc. to bring decentralized applications to the masses. Built on the zkSync ZK stack and leveraging EigenDA for data availability, Abstract offers a high-performance environment with near-instant transactions and extremely low fees. It focuses on the 'Consumer Crypto' category, prioritizing gaming, social media, and culture-driven apps. The network introduces the Abstract Global Wallet, allowing users to interact with dApps using passkeys and social logins, effectively abstracting away the complexities of blockchain technology for a seamless onboarding experience.
content.meta: Abstract is a ZK-powered Ethereum Layer 2 designed for consumer applications, offering high speed, low fees, and a frictionless user experience.
